questions.question: What is Isaiah 12?
options: A list of judgments on the nations
A vision of a coming battle
A lament over a fallen city
A song of thanksgiving and praise
questions.answer: A song of thanksgiving and praise

questions.question: What does the singer say God has become?
options: My faithful shepherd who leads me beside the still and quiet waters
My righteous judge who weighs the hearts of every one of us
My strength and my song, and he has become my salvation
My strong fortress and my shield against every one of my enemies
questions.answer: My strength and my song, and he has become my salvation

questions.question: Isaiah 12 says, 'With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.'
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be _____.
With joy you will draw water from the wells of _____.
